hypothesis: The failed aggregate test bias reflects persistent seasonal/regime drift rather than a small number of isolated extreme days: at least three test calendar months have model bias at or below -1C.
measurements: monthly MAE/RMSE/bias for validation and test

decision_rule.drift_confirmed: Permit preregistration of an expanding-retrain exploratory challenger; no tuning of the consumed test.
decision_rule.drift_not_confirmed: Investigate isolated errors/data quality before any new model.
